title: Logging 10,000 Years into the Future
altTitles: High Martial Art: Logging In 10,000 Years into the Future
Martial Art: Future's Ten Thousand Years
Gao Wu: Denglu Weilai Yi Wan Nian
description: At the dawn of the martial arts era, terrifying beasts invade the world and humanity's warriors repeatedly suffer defeat. Lu Sheng mysteriously gains the ability to enter a world 10,000 years in the future through his dreams. There, he discovers that humanity has already vanished, but its martial arts civilization reached an astonishing peak. Lu Sheng learns the advanced body-refining methods, breathing techniques, medicinal formulas, and martial laws left behind by the future, becoming the last person capable of carrying humanity's martial legacy forward.
author: Lie Ren
